roman_urdu_transliteration: Jazirah Usman yeh had bilad Usman ki hudud mein hai aur zamin panch jazirah mein aur wahan ke bashinday gabrorta hain aur lohri ki surh ro ropon ki kamal nihayat latif wahan hoti hai jazirah aqsaniyah yeh shami ki hudud mein hai aur bohat gehra hai naql hai ki badshah ne chaha ki iska gehra aur دریافت ho kashti mein sawar huwa aur is darya mein aya aur ek rasi mein langar bandah ko unhein dala jab woh khatam huwa dusra rasi aur band hiyan tak ki usti ki darazi char hazar gaz tak pohnchi magar os dya ko andaza maloom huwa magar langar tah par na pohncha akhir ko hath mein suo uthaya jazirah maswiyah fars ki buhairat mein se hai tul iska mein farsang ka hai aur so gardo nuwar mein nistan bohat hain jazirah tarkhan turkistan ki hudud mein hai aur iske door ki masafat char farsang ki hai aur sawa iske pani oska garam dusri koi khasiyat nahi rakhta hai jazirah nili yeh darya khat istwa ko janub ki taraf waqi hai aur door iska chalis farsang ka hai aur jazirah dazah isko ahir mein bhi kehte hain iski wajah yeh hai ki rod ahir mein awin age giri hai tul iska bis farsang ka hai jazirah armalinah bilad khazar ki hudud mein hai door iska assi farsang ka hai aur pani iska nihayat talkh hai aur iske darmiyan mein khair kasrat se hain aur zamin log kheti karte hain aur pani in jaziron ka meetha hai aur janwar yahan ajib ajib shakal ke hote hain jazirah fargham yeh jazirah kuchak hudud shamali mein waqi hai aur is darya ko ek zamin pani aisa siyah hota hai ki aur atraf ki pani mein zahir faraq maloom hota hai aur siyahi aur safidi dono barabar hain magar mutlaqan ek dusri mein mil nahi jati aur agar khak os kale pani mein gonda ko hup mein dal dein patthar ho jaye aur yeh darya nihayat gehra hai naql hai ki badshah zi iskahar ko دریافت ke liye chaudah hazar gaz ki rasi is zamin dali to tah par na pohnchi aur iska pani isqadar shafaf hai ki ba wasf itni baad ke aisa maloom hota hai ki gehra aur iska koi char gaz ka hoga naql hai ki kaykhusrow ke takht aur jam jahan numa ke lene ko qasd par shman gaye jo log ki iski neghebani par rehte the unhon ne isko is darya mein dal diya yasti ko bakri nikalna kisi ko nasib nawa jazirah panchar isko door ki masafat akiwi farsang ki hai aur bilad khazar ko darmiyan mein waqi hai aur noshirwan ne is darya par ek sad aliha banwai thi takay turkon ki shorish aur fasad se yeh diyar
